text:
Maya (Support): Autopay failed for BrightMart (PO-789). Customer says their saved card hit multiple declines — first insufficient_funds then a fraud check, and our retry triggered a 3DS which timed out. They're blocked from retrying. Can someone take a look? cc @Jon (Payments)

Jon (Payments): I pulled the payment trace — acquirer returned FRAUD_SCORE=92 on the second attempt. Autopay retried with 3DS redirect but ACS returned a timeout. Logged response: status=decline, reason=FRAUD_CHECK, code=402FRAUD. Please DM the request_id and raw logs.

Maya (Support): Request id sent in DM (req_0a1b2c3d... redacted). Customer urgently needs guidance; invoice is stuck as unpaid.

Priya (Eng): Is this hitting the silent-retry autopay path? Want to confirm if we skip challenge on first retry. Repro steps would help.

Jon (Payments): Repro I used locally: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/charge \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \
  -d '{"card_token":"tok_decline_fraud","amount":5000,"autopay":true,"po":"PO-789"}'
```
Response: 402 {"error":"declined","reason":"fraud","fraud_score":92} — then platform issued a 3DS redirect, ACS returned challenge_timeout.

Priya (Eng): I can reproduce with tok_decline_fraud. Observed in logs: `autopay: attempt=2, fallback=redirect, acs_time_ms=65000` — our challenge window is 60s so ACS latency pushed it over and we fell into acquirer fraud rules. Two actionable items: increase challenge timeout for autopay retries (e.g., 90s) and add alarm for ACS latencies.

Maya (Support): Customer worried raising timeout hurts UX for others. Any short-term mitigations?

Jon (Payments): Short term options: 1) Route BrightMart autopay traffic to Dedicated capacity where we can set a per-merchant longer challenge window; 2) Apply a merchant-level whitelist/override to allow manual review instead of auto-decline. Both require SRE/ops change.

Luca (Merchant SRE): I can enable a 24h merchant override for PO-789 to bypass automatic decline and route for manual review. Need approval from payments.

Jon (Payments): Approved. Luca go ahead. I'll mark the invoice for manual settlement if payment clears.

Maya (Support): :thumbsup: Thanks. I'll update the customer and share manual payment instructions.

Priya (Eng): I'll open an internal ticket to change the default autopay challenge timeout and add monitoring for `acs_time_ms > 50_000`. Will include a rollout plan with perf tests.

ECS-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-341 - High ACS latency affecting autopay. Assignees: Priya, Jon.

Jon (Payments): Also FYI billing saw one invoice flip to unpaid; flagging for collections so they don't auto-escalate.

Maya (Support): Leaving this thread open until customer confirms manual payment or override resolves it. Sending them the workaround now. Sensitive tokens redacted in public logs.

Priya (Eng): Follow-up: I'll post the PR link in this thread once timeout change is staged.

Luca (Merchant SRE): Override applied for 24h. Please confirm after customer tries again.
